items.title: File Widerspruch against the Wohnraumschutz order
items.quote: Ihr Widerspruch muss spätestens einen Monat nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids beim Bezirksamt Beispielbüttel, Grindelberg 62, 20144 Hamburg, eingehen – schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 2 Apr 2026, sent by an authority via ordinary post. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG the letter counts as delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Mon 6 Apr 2026 (this day does not shift even though it is a public holiday, Ostermontag, for this type of letter). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period for the Widerspruch starts the day after, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB it ends one month later on the same-numbered day: Wed 6 May 2026. That day is a normal working day in Hamburg, so no further shift under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG applies. The Widerspruch must reach (eingehen) the Bezirksamt by this date; to allow for postal transit it should be sent by about Wed 29 Apr 2026.

items.title: End short-term/holiday-guest rental and restore the flat to permanent residential use
items.quote: Wir geben Ihnen daher auf, die Vermietung an wechselnde Gäste zu beenden und die Wohnung wieder zum dauerhaften Wohnen zu nutzen oder zu vermieten.
items.computation: The order to stop the short-term letting and return the flat to permanent residential use is stated as an immediate obligation; the letter gives no specific calendar date or period for compliance (only that non-compliance may lead to a Zwangsgeld). No exact due date can therefore be computed from the text.

warnings: The letter does not name a fixed deadline or amount for ending the short-term rental itself; it only warns that a Zwangsgeld (coercive fine) 'can' be set if the order is not followed, without stating an amount or compliance date.

The IBAN printed in the footer (DE52 2005 0000 0001 0428 00, 'Hamburger Musterkasse') is well-formed but this letter does not actually request any payment; do not use this account to pay anything unless a separate invoice or Zwangsgeld notice explicitly requests it, and verify the payee name before transferring.
